name: ASCII Flow
description: Parameterized animated ASCII current with eight procedural glyphs, held pointer vortices, click fronts, three-band audio, and shifting phosphor hues.

name: Bayer Dither Interactive
description: Ordered 8x8 Bayer dither with blue-noise modulation, gather-style error diffusion, retro 1-bit/4-bit/8-bit palette switching, CRT phosphor dot pitch, and chromatic aberration on dither edges.

params.name: Bit Depth
params.description: Effective bit depth of the dithered output

params.name: Dither Spread
params.description: Spread of the Bayer dither threshold

params.name: Pixel Scale Max
params.description: Maximum scale of the pixelation effect

name: Byte-Mosh Glitch
description: LFSR/GF(2) datamosh corruption with spring cursor, held burst, capped ripple packets, wired zoom_params, regional FFT edges, and ACES output.

name: CRT Magnet
description: CRT degaussing distortion with continuous magnetic rings and rolling beam sweeps, held-pointer field gain, bounded click shocks, exact-load feedback echo, aperture grille, hex bloom, spectral palette, and preserved A-state packing.

name: CRT Phosphor Decay
description: Simulates CRT phosphor persistence with per-channel RGB decay rates, scanline masking, sub-pixel triad rendering, and halation bloom. Audio-reactive brightness flash and scanline flutter. Touch cursor adds static.

name: CRT TV - Phosphor Physics
description: Authentic CRT phosphor physics: curved-raster Gaussian scanlines whose beam fattens on bright rows, soft aperture grille, registered halation, barrel distortion inside a rounded-corner faceplate with curved-glass glare, a rolling ground-loop hum bar deepened by mids, held/click bulge, exact C persistence, and three-band audio.

name: Cyber Rain
description: Layered glyph downpour with three parallax rain sheets, per-column FFT bins, spring-free pointer bending (distinct from cyber-rain-em), bounded EMP rings, luminance wetness cling, exact C trails, and ACES display.

name: Cyber Terminal ASCII
description: Scrolling grid of luma-picked SDF glyphs in phosphor green (or colour-blended) with a binary decode lens at the cursor that widens while held, click packet bursts and C phosphor persistence. Ideas: hex-dump decode (lens cells show the two hex nibbles of their luma byte from a 4x6 bitmap font), typewriter row entry (the row entering at the bottom types in left-to-right behind a blinking block cursor at a bass-driven rate), and bit-error flicker (treble flips random glyphs to a neighbour index for one frame, leaving a brief green after-image). ACES display.

name: Data Moshing Diffusion
description: Anisotropic data-mosh diffusion with exact packed-state advection, rapid chromatic stream packets, held-pointer swirl, and click-launched smear fronts.

name: Data Moshing
description: Raw accumulated offset state in authoritative A drives motion-compensated macroblock smearing, sprung pointer scrubbing, bounded click corruption, three-band audio, ACES output, and semantic corruption alpha.

name: Datamosh Brush
description: Interactive MPEG datamosh brush with spring smear vector, macroblock edge geometry, capped click corruption bursts, alpha ghost trails, and three-band audio.

name: Digital Decay
description: Data corruption with spring hotspot, held burst, capped ripples, exact C ghost frames, block displacement, chromatic jitter, and ACES semantic alpha.

name: Digital Glitch (Pass 1)
description: Glitch field generation pass: spring corruption hotspot, held intensify, capped ripples, bitwise seeds, block displacement, and regional audio bands. Outputs field to dataTextureA.

params.name: Bit Manipulation
params.description: Type and amount of bitwise corruption

params.name: Error Propagation
params.description: Spread of corruption to neighboring pixels

name: Digital Waves
description: Cyber wave interference with hex quantization, spring cursor focus, held boost, capped ripples, regional FFT bins, and ACES tone map.

name: Film Gate Weave
description: 35mm gate weave with exact C scratch persistence (A packs rgb.r + scratch.g), spring registration anchor, held gate flutter, click splice flashes, and ACES tone mapping. Weave past the gate reveals the frame line and the neighbouring frame, persisted scratches wander a pixel per frame, and a reel-change cue dot flashes top-right every ~11 s.

name: Retro Halftone
description: Classic newspaper halftone dot pattern with adjustable scale, contrast, and color mode. Audio-reactive bass pulse modulates dot intensity.

name: Holographic Glitch
description: Continuous holographic scan and phase corruption with chromatic peel interaction, click desynchronization fronts, and channel-separated exact-history trails. Upgraded 2026-09-28: emitter flicker (random blackouts and slow luminance sag on the Flicker slider); grating-order ghosts (hue-split ±1-order copies along the shear axis, scaled by Holographic Intensity); peel shadow cast by the folded crest onto the image beneath.
feedbackPacking: A/C = pre-ACES linear display RGB + transmission alpha with bounded exact channel-separated trails; B is unused; ACES on writeTexture only

name: Holo-Projection Failure v2
description: Faulty holographic emitter simulation with CRT V-hold rolling, chromatic RGB beam desync, DAC bit-depth truncation, and phosphor beam persistence. Upgraded 2026-09-28: emitter cone (cyan carrier cast from bottom-centre; brightness and fringe pitch fall off with throw, alpha = carrier transmission); stale-frame tear bands that reveal the previous frame; re-sync lock line sweeping down inside the cursor repair circle (holding widens it and speeds the sweep).
feedbackPacking: A/C = pre-ACES linear display RGB + carrier-transmission alpha, read back for phosphor beam persistence and the stale-frame tear bands; B is unused; ACES on writeTexture only; depth passes through source depth.

name: Neon Edges
description: Multi-scale Mach-band edge enhancement colorized by blackbody temperature and depth-aware spotlighting.

params.name: Mach Strength
params.description: Boosts the directional second-derivative Mach bands

params.name: Spotlight Radius
params.description: Controls how tightly the mouse reveals depth edges

name: Phosphor Decay
description: Per-channel linear-feedback phosphor persistence with OkLab trail blending, bloom, shadow mask, scanlines and blackbody grading. Ideas: burn-in (a slow luma accumulator in the feedback alpha lowers phosphor efficiency so static content lingers as a dim negative ghost), held static charge (electrostatic crackle sparks at the cursor plus dust specks that cling to the glass and fade after release), and blanking-interval flicker (Scan Blanking drives a per-frame vertical-blank dip on the bottom rows). Cursor glow, capped click blooms, ACES display.

name: Pixel Rain
description: Multi-layer parallax matrix rain with spring repulsion, held burst, capped ripples, exact C trail fade, and three-band audio.

name: Pixelation Drift
description: Dynamic pixelated mosaic with audio-reactive pixel sizing, chromatic RGB pixel separation, depth-aware sizing, organic noise drift, and temporal persistence.

name: RGB Glitch Displacement
description: Digital glitch effect with RGB channel displacement, block glitches, scanlines, pixel sorting, and datamosh effects. Mouse-reactive wave displacement and chromatic aberration. Audio reactivity pulses glitch intensity and adds beat-synchronized flashes.
feedbackPacking: A packs offset.xy + glitchEnergy; writeTexture is ACES display RGBA; spring cursor extraBuffer[133..136]

name: RGB Glitch Trail
description: Mouse leaves chromatic aberration trails with alpha-channel translucency blending. Uses domain-warped FBM for organic displacement and computes alpha from glitch intensity * temporal persistence.

name: Scan Distort
description: CRT scanline tear with block quantization, held glitch bursts, exact C smear, capped click ripples, three-band audio, and ACES output. Upgraded with a sync-tear band (rows inside the glitch pulse slide along a sawtooth ramp and show stale rows from C), DCT-basis garble (corrupted blocks decode as hashed cosine basis patterns and the garbled set re-rolls with time), and MV arrows from a per-block temporal gradient (dots on still content).

name: Scanline Drift
description: Horizontal strip drift with RGB split: strips shear into each other like stretched tape, displaced lines reveal an h-sync blanking porch at the wrap seam, and fast-drifting strips smear along their velocity. Pointer band jitter, held boost, click tears, treble flicker, ACES output.

name: Signal Noise
description: Multi-octave analog noise with VHS head-switch bands, DCT artifacts, sprung cursor, held burst, capped ripples, exact C temporal smear, ACES output.

name: Spectral Glitch Sort
description: Brightness-gated spectral sorting with a guarded sprung epicenter, bounded click tears, read-only FFT block voices, and exact-C trails persisted through authoritative A display history.

name: Spectrum Bleed
description: Sprung spectrum-ink diffusion with bounded click splatters, read-only FFT shimmer, exact-C persistence, semantic display RGBA in authoritative A, and ACES output.

name: VHS Tracking Error
description: VHS capstan jitter and azimuth loss with sprung cursor, held tracking pull, capped dropout ripples, exact C row walk state, ACES output.

name: Vinyl Scratch
description: Vintage vinyl with spring stylus, held drag warp, click scratch bursts, groove sparkle exact-C coherence, ACES display, and semantic alpha from depth and groove mask.

name: Waveform Glitch
description: Oscilloscope Lissajous waveform glitch with signal aliasing and exact C phosphor trails. Upgraded 2026-09-28: a waveform-monitor trace plots the luma of the source row under the cursor; beam-dwell brightness makes slow Lissajous lobes burn brighter than fast crossings; treble block glitch slides whole quantisation cells sideways. Aspect-corrected scope, three-band audio, held burst, capped click ripples.
feedbackPacking: A/C = pre-ACES linear display RGB + semantic alpha (trail mix reads C as linear colour); B unused; ACES on writeTexture only.

name: Xerox Degrade
description: Repeated photocopy degradation with halftone dots, ordered dither, spring smear, held burst, capped ripples, exact C memory, and three-band audio.
